entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included in messages when the UE wishes to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the network. It requires that both the UE and network support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE includes the extended protocol configuration options IE when it wishes to transmit protocol data to the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network must support extended protocol configuration options end-to-end for the PDN connection for this IE to be used.

entities.name: PDN connection
entities.description: The extended protocol configuration options IE is supported end-to-end for the PDN connection when both UE and network support it.
